note: Phase 2 expected-control catalog. Completeness = do we hold current evidence for each expected (application, control)? appliesTo '*' means every onboarded application. Each entry's 'source' is 'legacy' (the original 18 hand-curated controls; evidence/demo fixtures and the Compliance page already depend on these IDs — do not rename or remove them, but new evidence must not be generated against them) or 'xlsx' (the 133 controls imported verbatim — control ID, control name and the verbatim Description column — from docs/ECS_Control_Library.xlsx, one sheet per framework: PCI DSS, DPSC, ITPP, OS Baselining, DB Baselining, NGINX Baselining, VAPT, C-SITE, ITDRM, Internal Audit). New/live evidence ingestion (Scheduler, manual/bulk upload) is guarded to accept only 'xlsx'-sourced (framework, controlId) pairs — see EvidenceControlCatalog.
